rule.note: Frozen 2026-08-26 before any forward data. Chosen because it was the best of the rules backtested on 1999-2018, NOT because it is expected to beat buy-and-hold: its information ratio against the benchmark was 0.046, which would need ~1900 years to distinguish from luck. This run exists to detect implementation bugs and regime breaks, and to keep the rule honest by making any later edit change the fingerprint.
